author: @CristinaSoltan-l2l
text:
“Rover: A Poem for KAI”

He walks with rhythm in every stride,
A mystery cloaked, with fire inside.
Not just a dancer, but flames on stage,
A soul untamed, unbound by cage.

“Call me Rover,” he softly sings,
A nomad soul with velvet wings.
Through beats that pulse and echoes wide,
He rides the night, no need to hide.

Grace in motion, fierce and smooth,
Each step a story, sharp yet smooth.
He isn’t lost—he’s seeking more,
A heart that knocks on every door.

Beyond the gloss, the flash, the fame,
KAI carves freedom in his name.
Not just EXO’s shadowed king,
But a legend with his own gold ring.

So let him roam, let him explore,
The world’s his stage, and he’s the roar.
With Rover’s gaze and lion’s might,
KAI dances through the velvet night.
